# Mezha

> > Mezha is a Ukrainian news platform providing coverage of the Russia-Ukraine war, regional conflicts in the Middle East, and international military operations.

Mezha delivers timely reporting on military strikes, civilian casualties, and geopolitical developments affecting Ukraine and neighboring regions. The platform covers critical events including Russian invasion updates, Israeli-Hezbollah conflicts, and infrastructure damage across war zones.

## Key Topics

- Russia-Ukraine War
- Russian Invasion
- Civilian Casualties
- Military Strikes & Airstrikes
- IDF Operations
- Israel-Hezbollah Conflict
- Lebanon Military Operations
- Kherson & Zaporizhzhia Regions
- Infrastructure Damage
- Middle East Conflicts
- Iranian Revolutionary Guard
- Evacuation Routes
- Lviv Region
- ISIS Operations
- Turkish-Syrian Intelligence

## Ukraine War: Russian Strikes & Civilian Impact

- [Civilian casualties after Russian strikes in Kherson](https://mezha.net/eng/bukvy/civilian-casualties-after-russian-strikes-in-kherson/): Russian strikes on Kherson civilian infrastructure cause casualties
- [Russian missiles hit Lviv airport](https://mezha.net/eng/bukvy/russian-missiles-hit-lviv-airport/): Russian airstrike damages Lviv airport facilities, no casualties reported
- [Обстріл Оріхова на Запорізькому напрямку 26 лютого 2026 року](https://mezha.net/ua/bukvy/russian-shelling-injures-71-civilians-in-orikhiv-zaporizhzhia-region/): Orikhiv shelling in Zaporizhzhia region injures 71 civilians
- [Blown bridge near Kyiv blocks a key interstate leading to Zhytomyr](https://mezha.net/eng/bukvy/blown-bridge-near-kyiv-blocks-a-key-interstate-leading-to-zhytomyr/): Bridge destroyed at Stoyanka disrupts Kyiv-Chop evacuation route

## Middle East: Israel-Hezbollah Operations

- [Israeli Forces Hit Hezbollah Targets Across Lebanon](https://mezha.net/eng/bukvy/israeli_forces_hit/): IDF strikes Hezbollah infrastructure across Lebanon targeting leadership
- [Туреччина зірвала план ІДІЛ у Дамаску, затримала трьох бойовиків](https://mezha.net/eng/bukvy/turechchina_zirvala_plan/): Turkish-Syrian intelligence foils ISIS attack in Damascus, arrests militants
